attributes.action: Pause New Carbon Capture and Storage Projects Until Safety Is Proven
attributes.additional_details: Before approving further CCUS projects or funding, the Government must require all Track 1 & 2 projects to complete 24 consecutive months of commercial operation from their verified start dates, with independently audited safety & environmental performance, and compliance with approved budgets & construction schedules. Project Skylark must publish its CO₂ pipeline safety findings, with risks independently assessed. Public safety, environmental protection and taxpayers’ money must take priority.
attributes.background: We call on the Government to pause approval of new CCUS projects until Track 1 and 2 projects have operated safely for two years, demonstrated compliance with construction budgets and timescales, and Project Skylark has published its findings on CO₂ pipeline safety risks.
